scope: Whole design dispositions; no implementation/commit/publish claim

objects.title: 产品范围与低负担委托
objects.rationale: 保留低人工负担；首用、目录和依赖由成熟组件和明确工作包组织，不让成员学习内部协议。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 协作宿主与本地运行器边界
objects.rationale: 沿用宿主模型、权限与真实工具；不重建代理平台，不把 skill 描述当宿主硬拦截。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 协议、判定、调用和存储分离
objects.rationale: 字段/准入/尝试/记录保持分责，通用实现可替换；禁止同义字段在主文、脚本各写一份。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 受控任务循环及完成语义
objects.rationale: 当前约定和正式集合为完成靶标；默认准则须细化，失败、未决写入和必要成员共同约束关闭。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 原始证据、事件与派生视图
objects.rationale: 原始字节、事件与判断保留各自证据等级，索引/回执只作派生。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 外置资产与任务化维护
objects.rationale: 任务化维护接纳正例、反馈、纠正及重复；维护决定可不变或暂缓，避免每次强制重流程。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 共享 skill 加可选分发适配
objects.rationale: 共享唯一 fairy 技能和成熟安装渠道，原生插件按宿主命名空间明确调用。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 稳定核心与外围增长
objects.rationale: 取消物理行数防膨胀，按职责/依赖/删除测试控制；库、工作流和策略配置在外围增长。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 整体组合及端到端保证
objects.rationale: 以完整首用、修订、集合交付、恢复、检索再用闭环验证，不把局部通过累加成系统效果。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 技能发现与调用入口
objects.rationale: 唯一 fairy 名称接标准目录、描述和宿主原生命令；自然语言选择仍软性。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 条件资料与按需披露
objects.rationale: 常规必需信息放主文及当前工作包；异常和作者参考按条件读，不能仅强化必须读取。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 环境就绪诊断
objects.rationale: 就绪诊断区分核心/索引/模型，真实进度和恢复入口，安装使用锁定原件。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 数据目录与任务工作区
objects.rationale: platformdirs 负责平台目录；显式 home 优先、任务私有目录和旧格式写前拒绝保留。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 建任务、默认标准和附件快照
objects.rationale: 严格捕获原始请求/材料，默认准则 provisional，模型交付前完成任务特定约定。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 严格 JSON 与命令字段契约
objects.rationale: JSON Schema 成熟库与严格解析保留；字段语义从单源提供精确下一动作载荷。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 要求来源与修订
objects.rationale: 要求修订绑定来源/revision；改动后的检查依真实影响重做，不自行弱化用户目标。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 关键提问与输入转发
objects.rationale: 移除终身三问，保留一待答和必要性策略；主动指示无须配合内部次数。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 模型工作请求与报告
objects.rationale: 真实请求/报告保持，模型判断不抬成工具见证；上下文读取免占工作额度。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 工具注册、字段发现与能力目录
objects.rationale: 发现用分页/完整定义句柄，完整 schema 不受短说明限制；发现结果不授予权限。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 动作准入、预算与重复防护
objects.rationale: 调用额度改宽裕预警/最终保护，重复和权限准入仍独立；不假称调用数限制单次执行时长。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 调用前留痕与执行后观测
objects.rationale: 保留执行前尝试和执行后观察，未知写入绑定原尝试，不盲目自动续跑。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 成果登记与版本绑定
objects.rationale: 从单 ref 改为完整不可变成员快照；同字节不同路径均有身份。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 文件捕获与类型标记
objects.rationale: 流式捕获和类型元数据，内容大小与 JSON/字段额度分离，输出须真实观察且有权使用。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 内容访问与分段读取
objects.rationale: 正文/资产/文档统一免费分段访问与句柄，短回包不限制原件长度。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 机械检查器
objects.rationale: 机械 checker 定义/参数/靶标固定，成员和集合分别覆盖；纯内容复用条件明确。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 语义审查、替代链和冲突
objects.rationale: 集合语义默认整份快照；失败适用性和显式重评保留，换名/重发不能清除失败。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 关闭门与结果分类
objects.rationale: complete 需细化约定、必要交付职责、当前检查和执行完整性；partial 如实列缺口。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 下一步工作包与调度
objects.rationale: 阶段工作包包含确切命令载荷和恢复身份；prepare-delivery 只组合现有已记录原语。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 回执与交付导出
objects.rationale: bagit-python 承担标准多文件打包和完整校验，根回执解释依据，正式成员均直接可访问。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: SQLite 存储与事务
objects.rationale: 保留 SQLite 事务与 expected_seq；大 BLOB 用原生增量 I/O，不另造内容事务引擎。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 事件链、序号与重放
objects.rationale: 事件链与序号仍为事实；资产事件兼作可重放投影日志，幂等水位接线。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 内容寻址与字节完整性
objects.rationale: 内容摘要只标字节，不充当成员身份；历史快照所有引用纳入完整性审计。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 路径约束、原子写与文件权限
objects.rationale: pathvalidate 加领域包含/冲突验证；私有暂存、同文件系统发布、输出权限延续。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 重开、未决动作与迟到结果
objects.rationale: 保留未知动作核对和迟到事实；新回执单独版本，不修改历史完整性记录。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 资产提案与工作流结构
objects.rationale: 工作流包增加适用范围、依赖/输入、完成要求、来源案例和失效条件，原包为权威。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 候选验证任务与固定策略
objects.rationale: 固定策略必须验证确切候选及适用性，候选仅出现在交付集合不能算完成验证。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 采用与基准竞争
objects.rationale: 采用/基准竞争在主库事务完成，检索近似相似不得自行采用或升级成熟度。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 资产状态、版本、退役与回退
objects.rationale: 新发现过滤权威可用头，历史钉选合法读取；修订/退役/回退不积累重复永久分支。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 资产检索与排序
objects.rationale: 采用 LanceDB ICU/BM25/向量/RRF 和成熟嵌入，正文/结构索引，真实状态/代次过滤。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 资产读取与精确版本钉选
objects.rationale: 短名单仅路由，执行前免费读必要适用信息和完整步骤，再核状态并钉确切版本。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 反馈与独立维护任务
objects.rationale: 交付后形成维护/暂缓/不变决定；信号保留 source task/seq/快照，后续会话可继续。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 资产分享与导入验证
objects.rationale: 版本化声明资产包、清理 provenance，本地验证再采用；不默认分享源任务私密材料。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 被动工具说明与内容信任
objects.rationale: 工具说明和资产被视为数据，不能扩大宿主授权；namespace 不冒充 ACL。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 资源限额与增长预算
objects.rationale: 43 项按语义/传输/内部块/存储/执行保护分层；保留必要兜底而非全面删限。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: CLI 错误、状态与诊断接口
objects.rationale: 结构化诊断带阶段/恢复身份，安全短错误外可续读；不静默截断，不伪造账单。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 自包含启动与可选 Python 包
objects.rationale: 独立 wheel 和技能脚本仍可用；准备 core/search/model 有固定锁与可观察就绪。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 便携 ZIP 内容过滤
objects.rationale: 便携包仍同源白名单，新的 fairy 目录/锁/许可进入测试，不夹带缓存和私有原件。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 派生版本、许可与包元数据同步
objects.rationale: 版本/许可/技能名/元数据单源核验；模型许可及权重身份独立登记。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 原生插件与市场清单
objects.rationale: 插件/市场指向唯一 fairy，并按原生命名空间展示；不增薄转发技能。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 可选 UI 元数据
objects.rationale: UI 默认提示与 fairy 身份同源，软性匹配和宿主差异明确。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 测试面、类型与规范检查
objects.rationale: 保留风格/类型/真实收集门，新增集合、行为、检索、资源和恢复真实验证。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 提交门与 CI 构建
objects.rationale: 提交/CI 不绕门；组件与模型锁、分发同源、实际安装进入相应执行通道。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 文档、单源组织与公开边界
objects.rationale: 更新架构/协议/主文/中英说明及给维护者的讲解；历史报告保持原基准不倒写。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 研究来源与验证声明
objects.rationale: 每项成熟采用绑定权威原件、实际接口和接线验收；声明不超过实际探针/模型/平台证据。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 首次任务到交付
objects.rationale: 首用自动就绪、完整主文、工作包、低负担约定、多文件交付连续跑通。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 要求变化到重新验收
objects.rationale: 新指示产生真实 revision/检查变化；模型解释组织依据而非要求成员操作状态机。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 中断到恢复与迟到结果
objects.rationale: 中断保留已提交阶段，未知动作核对，迟到事实产生新回执，不重试有风险原语。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 经验到下一次任务收益
objects.rationale: 成功/纠正信号形成资产，混合检索找到并判适用，实际再用净收益独立验收。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 发送到接收端独立使用
objects.rationale: 接收端不依赖原任务私有库；导入候选验证确切内容，传播不等于采用。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 公开源到多宿主安装与升级
objects.rationale: 标准 skill/wheel/plugin 同源，现有宿主原生方式验证；无开发期兼容别名。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 规模增长及外部能力替换
objects.rationale: 分块、索引投影和资源策略可变，核心不随资产/工具增长改分支；ANN 后续按量测启用。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 权限与副作用贯穿路径
objects.rationale: 资产、预处理组合和成熟组件不越权限；所有真实副作用仍由已有准入及观察承接。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 使用者思路进步的证据路径
objects.rationale: 收集真实提问/反馈变化作长期证据，不把短期技术通过冒称人已进步。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 重复任务成熟与回流触发
objects.rationale: 成熟度看声明适用性、正反例和净收益，允许成功沉淀与不变，不用固定次数晋升。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 检索需求的语义覆盖
objects.rationale: 中文长句/同义/跨语/正文与不适用独立留出检验，完整字段与算法贡献分离。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 长期数据保留与版本演化
objects.rationale: 历史捕获及事件不删；新开发格式写前拒绝、旧数据保留，不承诺无限磁盘或旧协议兼容。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 原生宿主及平台支持证据
objects.rationale: 支持矩阵以实际 wheel/宿主任务为准，不把标准目录正确当所有宿主安装已证。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 审核者理解组织依据的能力
objects.rationale: 直接成果链接加组织理由/关键依据/假设/检查范围，完整回执另查，避免流水账代解释。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 未知效果恢复的操作闭环
objects.rationale: 核对原尝试的操作路径暴露于 next，不能靠口头确认抹去未知写入。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 声明式工具契约、运行环境与 Schema 准入
objects.rationale: 保留声明式合同及成熟 schema 库，扩大合理合同初值并按确切字段生成载荷。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 权威尝试核对与当前执行完整性
objects.rationale: 当前完整性从原尝试及权威观察核对，迟到事实不被旧 complete 记录覆盖。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 有界回包、免费文档选读与恢复标识
objects.rationale: 统一免费读取和分页、受控回包、精确恢复 ID；回包保护不挤压工作执行额度。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 共享认证文档、局部读取与全量审计
objects.rationale: 保留认证文档结构、免费选择读取和全量审计，内部节点/扇出/缓存不盲目扩大。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 记录寿命、完整审计、备份与新目录恢复
objects.rationale: 所有历史集合纳入备份闭包；主库先文档后保证仍有效，检索缓存恢复后重建。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 初始约定严格归一化与附件原子捕获
objects.rationale: 原始请求严格归一化及附件原子捕获保持；允许大请求引用而非静默截掉。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 候选策略验证与精确采用绑定
objects.rationale: 候选验证精确内容/策略与通过证据绑定，集合成员包含关系不能替代。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 真实测试收集与执行通道
objects.rationale: 真实测试收集与 CI/dev 执行渠道保留并扩展，禁止只有目录无执行通道。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

objects.title: 哈希锁定依赖、就绪检查与首次启动
objects.rationale: 哈希锁定核心/检索/构建及模型，用户首启动有准备进度，不使用本轮临时探针环境分发。
objects.meaning: Design disposition, not a claim of implemented or reverified runtime behavior

unbounded_or_host_managed: Host tokens/cost/time remain real host measurements or unknown; do not fabricate billing
Trusted arbitrary same-process handler cancellation depends on host/adapter; call quotas are not timeouts
Retained history has no automatic deletion in this design; capacity monitoring and recoverable disk-full failure remain required
calibration_rule: New numeric values are deliberately generous implementation inputs, not measured promises. W05 tests normal workloads and explicit abnormal cases, records actual default changes, then freezes the single typed policy. It cannot waive permission, evidence, integrity or exact-target invariants.
